title: Luna's Big Day
style: Soft pastel kawaii cartoon with thick outlines, rounded shapes, and cheerful colors

start.scene: Luna the unicorn standing in a sunny meadow beside a sparkling blue stream, surrounded by colorful wildflowers and green trees with a sunrise behind rolling hills.
start.text: Luna the unicorn wakes up on a sunny morning. Where should she go today?

a.scene: Luna in a sunlit forest clearing surrounded by colorful butterflies, with a friendly squirrel waving from a thick brown tree branch, flowers dotting the ground.
a.text: In the forest, a little squirrel waves hello. 'Will you play with me today?'

b.scene: Luna trotting on a sandy beach with a red-and-white striped sailboat bobbing on the sparkling blue water, palm trees on a sandy rise to the right.
b.text: At the beach, Luna finds a little sailboat. The sea sparkles!

aa.scene: Luna and a cheerful squirrel beside a large pile of brown acorns under a big green tree in a meadow at sunset.
aa.text: Together they find a mountain of acorns! The squirrel is so thankful. What now?

ab.scene: Luna peeking out from behind a giant red-and-white spotted mushroom in the forest, with a rabbit, squirrel, hedgehog, and blue bird gathered among smaller mushrooms and a fallen log.
ab.text: Luna is the best hider in the forest! All the animals want more fun.

ba.scene: Luna aboard a wooden sailboat at a pink sunset, a friendly blue whale spraying a sparkly water spout beside her, a small orange bonfire glowing on a distant sandy island.
ba.text: A friendly whale swims up and sprays a sparkly hello! Far away on the beach, a little bonfire starts to glow.

bb.scene: Luna on a beach beside a tall sandcastle decorated with colorful bunting and flags, a small orange crab, a golden crown on the sand, and a striped sailboat on the water at sunset.
bb.text: The sandcastle is magnificent, and a little crab wants to be its king!

end_party.scene: Luna wearing a daisy crown sitting on a checkered picnic blanket with forest animals sharing acorns from baskets under colorful paper lanterns at sunset.
end_party.text: The whole forest comes to Luna's acorn party! What a wonderful day. The End!

end_rainbow.scene: Luna sliding joyfully down a broad rainbow arcing over a flower-dotted green meadow with bunnies and birds at sunset.
end_rainbow.text: What a forest adventure! Luna slides all the way home on a rainbow. Sweet dreams, Luna! The End!

end_crown.scene: Luna wearing a daisy crown in a sunny forest clearing surrounded by cheering rabbits, squirrels, a hedgehog, a deer, and birds.
end_crown.text: The animals weave Luna a crown of daisies — Hide-and-Seek Champion of the whole forest! The End!

end_pearl.scene: Luna floating inside a shimmering bubble underwater holding a glowing pearl, a friendly blue whale beside her among colorful fish and coral.
end_pearl.text: The whale shows Luna a glowing pearl — a gift for her bravery! The End!

end_crab.scene: Luna looking up at a proud crab wearing a green cape atop a tall decorated sandcastle with bunting and shell towers on the beach.
end_crab.text: King Crab rules the grandest sandcastle on the beach. Long live the king! The End!

end_bonfire.scene: Luna dancing on a moonlit beach around a crackling bonfire with seagulls, crabs, and a whale spouting in the starry night sea.
end_bonfire.text: Luna hurries to the glowing bonfire on the twinkly beach, and everyone dances until the stars come out. The End!
